import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for author, title, body and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Args: author: The author's name. title: Title of the post. body: Main content of the post. post_tags: List of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing safe HTML for the post. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Build tag spans safely escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML with sanitized parts return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
